cues.en: Instructor: In this video, I'm going to tell you about a decomposition method called, Principle Components Analysis, often abbreviated PCA.
cues.zh: 講師：這支介紹主成分分析，常縮寫 PCA，這種分解方法。

cues.en: So I'll explain the concept of PCA and using PCA for compression, for data compression or dimension reduction.
cues.zh: 解釋概念，以及如何用於資料壓縮與降維。

cues.en: I'm gonna give a simplified overview of the math.
cues.zh: 提供簡化的數學概觀。

cues.en: Now, the math underlying principle components analysis is not really super duper complicated, but it does rely on some topics in advanced linear algebra
cues.zh: 背後數學不算超複雜，但依賴一些進階線性代數，

cues.en: that I am not going to go into here.
cues.zh: 這裡不深入。

cues.en: In fact, I have a whole course on PCA.
cues.zh: 其實我有整門 PCA 課。

cues.en: And between covariance matrices and PCA, it's probably around eight hours of lecture that just to get into really all the nitty gritty details of PCA.
cues.zh: 共變異數矩陣加 PCA，大概八小時，才詳細探討所有細節。

cues.en: So you can imagine that this particular video is going to be a fairly, you know, bird's eye overview of the math.
cues.zh: 所以這支只能從鳥瞰角度看數學。

cues.en: And I'm also gonna talk about in important, appropriate interpretations of PCA and also some limitations of PCA that make it sometimes difficult to interpret
cues.zh: 也會討論適當、重要的解讀，以及限制，可能造成難以解讀，

cues.en: or maybe not the most appropriate method to use in all cases.
cues.zh: 或某些情況不是最適方法。

cues.en: So let's get started by looking at some data.
cues.zh: 先看資料。

cues.en: So obviously there's a pretty strong correlation structure in these data.
cues.zh: 顯然有很強的相關結構。

cues.en: Now, in the original data space, we have variable X and variable Y.
cues.zh: 原始資料空間有 X 與 Y。

cues.en: So this is what the data looked like in the data space.
cues.zh: 這是資料在原空間的樣子。

cues.en: But it's pretty clear that the main axis that's important for the data is not this axis, and it's not this axis.
cues.zh: 但重要主軸，顯然不是這條，也不是那條。

cues.en: There's another axis in these data that actually much better capture the features of the correlation structure of the data.
cues.zh: 另一條軸能更好捕捉相關結構。

cues.en: And that would be an axis that looks like this.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: So we can say this is a really important axis.
cues.zh: 可以說，這是很重要的軸。

cues.en: This is a principle axis in the data distribution.
cues.zh: 資料分布的主軸。

cues.en: And then here's another axis here.
cues.zh: 另外還有這條軸。

cues.en: Now we have two variables.
cues.zh: 兩個變數。

cues.en: So we have a two dimensional data space.
cues.zh: 所以二維空間。

cues.en: So our, any other way of carving up this space is also going to be two dimensional.
cues.zh: 換其他方式切分，仍然是二維。

cues.en: Okay, so the idea of PCA is to identify these vectors here.
cues.zh: PCA 就是辨識這些向量，

cues.en: These directions in this multivariate correlated space.
cues.zh: 多變量相關空間中的方向。

cues.en: So then the, exactly these same data in PC space will look like this.
cues.zh: 完全相同資料，在主成分空間像這樣。

cues.en: Where instead of having variable X and variable Y as the dimensions, we have PC one and PC two as the dimensions.
cues.zh: 維度不再是 X、Y，而是 PC1、PC2。

cues.en: So now you can see that we've just reoriented the data without changing them.
cues.zh: 只是重新定向，沒改變資料。

cues.en: All we've done is rotate the data.
cues.zh: 只有旋轉。

cues.en: It's an exact perfect rotation.
cues.zh: 完全精確的旋轉。

cues.en: We just take the data and we spin them so that they are, so that most of the concentration of the data is along PC one.
cues.zh: 把資料轉一下，讓最大集中程度沿 PC1。

cues.en: And then the next most amount of variance is aligned to PC two.
cues.zh: 次多變異則沿 PC2。

cues.en: And of course, this is two dimensional, but if we had three dimensional data, then we would have a PC three that would point in some other orthogonal direction here.
cues.zh: 這裡二維，如果三維，還有 PC3，指向另一個正交方向。

cues.en: Okay, so one of the things that we can do once we've applied this principle components analysis, is something called data compression.
cues.zh: 做完 PCA，可以進行資料壓縮。

cues.en: Now, data compression is the idea of flattening some of the dimensions in the data space because we assume that those are just noise.
cues.zh: 把資料空間某些維度壓平，因為假設它們只是雜訊。

cues.en: That's not real variability or meaningful variability.
cues.zh: 不是真正、有意義的變異。

cues.en: So for example, let's say, you know, we imagine that all of the distances along this PC one axis, these are meaningful.
cues.zh: 例如，假設沿 PC1 的距離有意義。

cues.en: The fact that this dot is further away than this dot on this axis, that is meaningful.
cues.zh: 這點在軸上比那點遠，有意義。

cues.en: We are starting from that assumption.
cues.zh: 先做這個假設。

cues.en: But then, you know, let's say I assume that PC two is just noise.
cues.zh: 但假設 PC2 只是雜訊。

cues.en: So the fact that this thing is below and this thing is above the line, this thing is a little bit further below compared to this one, I'm just assuming that this is random variance.
cues.zh: 這點在下、那點在上，這點比那點更往下，只是隨機變異。

cues.en: This is just sampling variability, it's noise.
cues.zh: 只是抽樣變異、雜訊。

cues.en: I don't think that that is a meaningful part of the data.
cues.zh: 不認為是有意義的資料部分。

cues.en: So therefore, I'm going to compress down to one dimension, down to the first principle component.
cues.zh: 因此壓成一維，只保留第一主成分。

cues.en: And then we have the data that look like this.
cues.zh: 資料變這樣。

cues.en: Now, this has two advantages.
cues.zh: 有兩個好處。

cues.en: One, it just makes our analysis simpler because instead of having two dimensions to the data, now we only have one dimension of the data.
cues.zh: 第一，分析更簡單，二維變一維。

cues.en: Now you can imagine that, you know, going from two dimensions to one dimension isn't such a big deal.
cues.zh: 二維變一維，似乎沒什麼。

cues.en: But you can imagine if we would start off at six dimensions and we go down to two, now all of a sudden we can visualize the data in two dimensions,
cues.zh: 但如果六維變二維，就突然能畫二維圖，

cues.en: whereas we couldn't visualize the data in six dimensions.
cues.zh: 原本六維無法視覺化。

cues.en: So this is the idea.
cues.zh: 就是這個概念。

cues.en: When we compress data, what we're doing is taking each data point and projecting it onto the axes that we care about
cues.zh: 壓縮資料，就是把每點投影到關心的軸，

cues.en: and flattening out the axes that we don't care about.
cues.zh: 壓平不關心的軸。

cues.en: So PC two has been completely squashed.
cues.zh: PC2 完全壓扁。

cues.en: It's been totally flattened.
cues.zh: 徹底壓平。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the general idea of a principle components analysis.
cues.zh: 這是主成分分析的一般概念。

cues.en: It looks pretty neat, it seems like, you know, how does that work?
cues.zh: 很有意思，怎麼做到？

cues.en: How do we get to do that?
cues.zh: 如何完成？

cues.en: So I'm going to now give you a quick overview of the math.
cues.zh: 簡單概述數學。

cues.en: And, if you've taken linear algebra before then I hope you're able to follow along.
cues.zh: 上過線性代數，希望能跟上。

cues.en: And if you've never taken a linear algebra course, then don't worry about it.
cues.zh: 沒上過也不用擔心。

cues.en: What's important for now is more the concept and less so the details of the implementation.
cues.zh: 目前概念比實作細節重要。

cues.en: Okay so, PCA works by starting from a covariance matrix.
cues.zh: PCA 從共變異數矩陣開始。

cues.en: Now you already know what a covariance matrix is, how to create one, and how to interpret one.
cues.zh: 你知道它是什麼、如何建立與解讀。

cues.en: So this is just, you know, an image going from this particular data set into a covariance matrix.
cues.zh: 這張圖表示從這份資料轉成共變異數矩陣。

cues.en: In fact, this is the same data set that we worked with earlier in the course.
cues.zh: 其實是課程之前用過的同一資料集。

cues.en: So we take our covariance matrix and we perform something called an eigen decomposition, also sometimes called an eigenvalue decomposition.
cues.zh: 對共變異數矩陣做特徵分解，也稱特徵值分解。

cues.en: An eigen decomposition is a matrix operation that starts from a square matrix of the same number of rows and columns, which is definitely the case for a covariance matrix,
cues.zh: 從列數與欄數相同的方陣開始，共變異數矩陣肯定符合，

cues.en: and breaks that down.
cues.zh: 再分解。

cues.en: It decomposes this matrix into a set of eigenvectors and associated eigenvalues.
cues.zh: 成為一組特徵向量，以及對應特徵值。

cues.en: So each eigenvector has an associated eigenvalue.
cues.zh: 每個向量都有對應值。

cues.en: Now, this eigenvector has the same number of elements as the number of elements in a column of the covariance matrix.
cues.zh: 向量元素數，與共變異數矩陣一欄的元素數相同。

cues.en: So if we have, you know, M by M features, then the eigenvectors have M elements in them.
cues.zh: M 乘 M 特徵，向量有 M 個元素。

cues.en: And that in fact is what we do in A PCA is we multiply the eigenvector by the original data that was used to create this covariance matrix.
cues.zh: PCA 就是把特徵向量，與產生共變異數矩陣的原始資料相乘。

cues.en: So the eigenvector is a way of taking a weighted combination of all the different features in your dataset.
cues.zh: 向量讓資料集不同特徵做加權組合。

cues.en: And so that's the eigenvectors.
cues.zh: 這是特徵向量。

cues.en: And then the eigenvalues are just single numbers.
cues.zh: 特徵值則是單一數字。

cues.en: Now the idea is that the eigenvectors point in some direction in the data space.
cues.zh: 向量指向資料空間某個方向。

cues.en: But these all point, or the arrows here, the eigenvectors are all the same length.
cues.zh: 但所有箭頭、向量長度相同。

cues.en: So the eigenvectors don't tell us which directions are more important and which directions are less important.
cues.zh: 所以不告訴我們哪個方向更重要。

cues.en: That's what we need the eigenvalues for.
cues.zh: 需要特徵值。

cues.en: So let me just go back to this example here.
cues.zh: 回到例子。

cues.en: So in this case, this would be eigen, the eigenvector associated with the larger eigenvalue.
cues.zh: 這個向量對應較大的特徵值。

cues.en: And this would be the eigenvector associated with the smaller eigenvalue.
cues.zh: 這個對應較小的。

cues.en: So we start off with these data, we take the, we compute the covariance matrix, which is gonna be a two by two matrix because we have two variables, and then we take the eigen decomposition of
cues.zh: 先算共變異數矩陣，兩變數所以 2 乘 2，再對它做

cues.en: that covariance matrix.
cues.zh: 特徵分解。

cues.en: And then, the eigenvector associated with the larger eigenvalue is the first principle component.
cues.zh: 較大特徵值所對應向量，是第一主成分。

cues.en: And then the second principle component is the eigenvector associated with the smaller eigenvalue.
cues.zh: 較小所對應，是第二主成分。

cues.en: Okay, again if that all sounds like gibberish, then don't worry about it.
cues.zh: 聽起來像胡言亂語也不用擔心。

cues.en: The main point is, we get a set of values that tell us how important each direction is, and we get a set of eigenvectors which are the principle components,
cues.zh: 重點是，有一組值說明各方向重要性，也有一組特徵向量、主成分，

cues.en: and those are ways of rotating the data.
cues.zh: 用來旋轉資料。

cues.en: They're ways of linearly combining the different features of the data.
cues.zh: 線性組合不同資料特徵。

cues.en: So then what you do in a PCA is look at the spectrum of eigenvalues.
cues.zh: PCA 接著看特徵值譜。

cues.en: So you sort the eigenvalues and you plot them as a function of the component number.
cues.zh: 排序，對成分編號畫圖。

cues.en: So then you see they're all gonna go down, of course, because we're sorting them.
cues.zh: 當然一路下降，因為排序了。

cues.en: And then what you wanna look for is the large eigenvalues that pop out of this spectrum.
cues.zh: 找特別突出的高特徵值。

cues.en: So you see these are all really, really close to each other, and they're also very close to zero.
cues.zh: 這些彼此接近，也接近 0。

cues.en: And then we get, certainly this one and maybe two or three that really pop out from the rest of the spectrum.
cues.zh: 這個肯定，可能還有第二、第三個，明顯突出。

cues.en: So these we consider to be the important components of the data.
cues.zh: 視為重要成分。

cues.en: And these would be less important components.
cues.zh: 這些比較不重要。

cues.en: So these are generally interpretable.
cues.zh: 這些一般可以解讀。

cues.en: There are statistical methods for determining whether these components are statistically significant, but I'm not going to go into detail about that.
cues.zh: 有統計方法判定成分是否顯著，但不深入。

cues.en: So we say that visually when you see these eigenvalues popping out of the spectrum, those are possibly interpretable.
cues.zh: 視覺上從譜中突出，可能可解讀。

cues.en: And then the rest of this, yeah, some people call this the noise spectrum.
cues.zh: 其餘有人叫雜訊譜。

cues.en: I prefer to call it the low variance components because these are features in the data that have relatively small covariance.
cues.zh: 我偏好叫低變異成分，因為是共變異數相對小的特徵。

cues.en: But that doesn't mean that they're noise, it just means that, you know, the correlations across the different data features are not as strong as the correlations are for these components.
cues.zh: 不代表雜訊，只是不同資料特徵間相關，沒有這些成分強。

cues.en: So if you had an eigenspectrum like this, then what you could do is compress the data down.
cues.zh: 如果譜像這樣，可以壓縮。

cues.en: We start off with, it looks like 21 dimensions, and we could look at these data and say, well you know, there's three large directions in these data
cues.zh: 原本似乎 21 維，可以說有三個主要方向，

cues.en: and I'm not sure what's going on with these other guys.
cues.zh: 其他不確定是什麼。

cues.en: So we could compress this down to three dimensions.
cues.zh: 所以壓到三維。

cues.en: We could have three features in the data instead of having 21 features of the data.
cues.zh: 21 個特徵，變三個。

cues.en: So that would be the way that you would use PCA for dimension compression.
cues.zh: 這是用 PCA 做維度壓縮的方法。

cues.en: Now all that said, you know, that sounds really great.
cues.zh: 聽起來很好。

cues.en: I just wanna highlight two limitations of PCA.
cues.zh: 但凸顯兩個限制。

cues.en: These are not necessarily disadvantages in all cases, but these are features of PCA that are important to keep in mind because it's important to realize
cues.zh: 不一定每次都是缺點，但必須記住這些特性，了解

cues.en: that PCA is not just some magical tool.
cues.zh: PCA 並非魔法工具。

cues.en: You know, you wave your wand and you know you get brilliant results and the compression is great.
cues.zh: 不是揮魔杖就有精彩結果、良好壓縮。

cues.en: You can actually compress data in a way that makes the results seem even more confusing and even less sensible than the original data
cues.zh: 資料壓縮的方式，可能讓結果比原始資料更加混亂、更加不合理，

cues.en: in the higher dimensional space.
cues.zh: 也就是比原本高維空間中的資料更難理解。

cues.en: So let me highlight these two limitations.
cues.zh: 兩個限制如下。

cues.en: One is that all of the components, all of the principle components are forced to be orthogonal.
cues.zh: 第一，所有主成分被強制正交。

cues.en: What does orthogonal mean?
cues.zh: 正交是什麼？

cues.en: Well, there's a geometric interpretation of orthogonal.
cues.zh: 有幾何解讀。

cues.en: It's when two vectors meet at a 90 degree angle, but more relevant for us here is the algebraic interpretation.
cues.zh: 兩向量夾角 90 度，但這裡更重要是代數解讀。

cues.en: And that means that the correlation between any two principle components is necessarily zero.
cues.zh: 任兩主成分的相關必為 0。

cues.en: It's not that, you know they're sort of small, it's that there are mathematical constraints that force the principle components to be exactly zero correlated.
cues.zh: 不是稍小，而是數學限制強制精確零相關。

cues.en: Now, that's not intrinsically good or bad, but it can lead to some unexpected results.
cues.zh: 本身無所謂好壞，但可能有意外結果。

cues.en: For example, consider this data set here.
cues.zh: 例如這份資料。

cues.en: All these little blue circles, it looks like a bubbly X that's being swept away by the wind or something.
cues.zh: 藍圈像被風吹走、由泡泡構成的 X。

cues.en: So clearly when you look at this data set, you see that there are these two strands here.
cues.zh: 很清楚有兩條分支。

cues.en: Like there's these two patterns in the data.
cues.zh: 兩種模式。

cues.en: And yet, the PCA shows eigenvector's principle components that point in this direction, and in this direction.
cues.zh: 但 PCA 的特徵向量、主成分指向這邊與那邊。

cues.en: This is the second principle component, this is the first principle component.
cues.zh: 這是第二，這是第一主成分。

cues.en: Now, when you look at this, that might feel intuitively wrong because you might think that the important directions of the data are like this and this,
cues.zh: 直覺可能覺得錯，重要方向應該這樣、那樣，

cues.en: or maybe you know, pointing this way.
cues.zh: 或指向這邊。

cues.en: But in fact, PCA is doing the right thing here.
cues.zh: 但 PCA 做得正確。

cues.en: It's doing exactly what it's supposed to do.
cues.zh: 正是它該做的。

cues.en: Which is to identify the directions of maximal covariance between the two axes.
cues.zh: 辨識兩軸間共變異數最大的方向。

cues.en: And so the maximal covariance direction is in this direction, even though that seems a little bit awkward.
cues.zh: 最大方向在這裡，雖然有點彆扭。

cues.en: Now, on the other hand, we can run an independent components analysis on the same data.
cues.zh: 另一方面，同資料可做獨立成分分析。

cues.en: And I'll talk more about independent components analysis in a couple of videos from now.
cues.zh: 幾支之後談。

cues.en: So that seems to have produced more sensible results to our eye.
cues.zh: 視覺上似乎更合理。

cues.en: Now, it's certainly not fair to say that ICA is right and PCA is wrong here.
cues.zh: 但不能公平地說 ICA 對、PCA 錯。

cues.en: But what definitely is going on here is that PCA is just keying in on different features of the data.
cues.zh: PCA 只是在捕捉不同資料特徵。

cues.en: It's looking for something completely different than what ICA is looking for.
cues.zh: 尋找與 ICA 完全不同的東西。

cues.en: So depending on what kind of question you have, what assumptions you make about the data, you can get very different results from different methods of dimensionality reduction
cues.zh: 因此，根據你的問題，以及對資料所做的假設，不同的降維方法可能得到非常不同的結果，

cues.en: and components analysis.
cues.zh: 成分分析方法也是如此。

cues.en: A second feature of principle components analysis is that PCA says that variance equals relevance.
cues.zh: 第二特性，PCA 認為變異等於重要性。

cues.en: Now that means that whatever features in the data have the most amount of variance and the most amount of covariance across the different variables, that is what PCA is going to pick up on.
cues.zh: 變異最多、不同變數間共變異最多的特徵，就是它捕捉的。

cues.en: So if you have potentially really meaningful, important features of the data, but those patterns in the data are isolated to a small number of characteristics of the data,
cues.zh: 如果有非常有意義、重要特徵，但模式僅存在於少數資料特性，

cues.en: small number of features, or a small number of columns in your data matrix, then PCA might actually look at that and say, well, you know, you are not strongly correlated
cues.zh: 少數特徵、少數矩陣欄，PCA 可能說，你與其他很多東西

cues.en: with a lot of other things, so therefore I'm going to get rid of you.
cues.zh: 相關不強，所以移除。

cues.en: You know, it's suppressing the things that are a little unusual.
cues.zh: 壓抑有點不尋常的東西。

cues.en: And the unusual things might be the most important.
cues.zh: 但不尋常的，可能最重要。

cues.en: So this is an example taken from this paper here where you know, imagine we know as the data scientists, we know that color is the important dimension here.
cues.zh: 這個例子來自這篇論文，假設資料科學家知道顏色是重要維度。

cues.en: But PCA is actually totally unable to isolate the color dimension because it's just focused on this large scale structure here.
cues.zh: PCA 卻完全無法分離顏色維度，只聚焦大尺度結構。

cues.en: Now, depending on what kind of data you have, where the data come from, what is the nature of the data, it's actually possible that the largest sources of variants in the data
cues.zh: 根據資料的類型、來源與性質，資料中最大的變異來源，

cues.en: are actually noise or artifacts.
cues.zh: 可能其實是雜訊或假影。

cues.en: Because noise and artifacts tend to be large amplitude.
cues.zh: 因為雜訊、假影振幅常很大。

cues.en: And so it could be that if you are compressing data, you're actually pushing out signal, you're removing signal from your dataset
cues.zh: 因此，壓縮資料時，可能其實排擠掉訊號，從資料集中移除訊號，

cues.en: and just preserving the artifacts that are present in the dataset.
cues.zh: 卻只保留資料集中的假影。

cues.en: So again, this you know, this doesn't mean that PCA is bad, it just means you have to be careful when applying PCA.
cues.zh: 不是 PCA 不好，而是使用要小心。

cues.en: You shouldn't treat it like it's an amazing method that's just going to work by waving a magic wand.
cues.zh: 不應當成揮魔杖就成功的驚人方法。

cues.en: I hope you see this is also conceptually a bit similar to K-means clustering.
cues.zh: 概念上有點像 K-means。

cues.en: Where we saw that K-means clustering can be really amazing, it can be a really powerful method when the data conformed to the assumptions of K-means clustering.
cues.zh: 資料符合假設時，K-means 很驚人、強大。

cues.en: Likewise, PCA can be a really powerful method when the data conformed to the assumptions underlying PCA.
cues.zh: 同樣，符合 PCA 假設時，它也強大。

cues.en: Which in this case they are.
cues.zh: 這個例子確實如此。

cues.en: Okay, so some quick conclusions.
cues.zh: 快速整理。

cues.en: PCA is great for dimension compression, dimensionality reduction, and visual exploration of high dimensional data.
cues.zh: PCA 適合維度壓縮、降維與高維資料的視覺探索。

cues.en: But PCA may be suboptimal.
cues.zh: 但可能不是最佳。

cues.en: It can even be misleading when interpreting principle components as being unique sources of variance in the data or factors in the data.
cues.zh: 把主成分解讀為資料中獨特的變異來源或因子，甚至可能誤導。

cues.en: So in this video, I tried to give you a intuitive feeling for what PCA is.
cues.zh: 這支嘗試讓你直覺了解 PCA。

cues.en: I talked about the math a little bit in terms of eigen decomposition and interpreting the eigenvalues.
cues.zh: 稍談特徵分解與特徵值解讀的數學。

cues.en: And I talked about some of the appropriate uses and some of the limitations of PCA.
cues.zh: 也談適當使用方式與限制。
